Mô tả công việc
Tham gia phát triển và bảo trì các hệ thống phần mềm sử dụng Java (Spring framework).
Phối hợp với các thành viên trong nhóm để phân tích yêu cầu, thiết kế, viết tài liệu kỹ thuật và triển khai tính năng.
Làm việc với cơ sở dữ liệu như MySQL, SQL Server.
Hỗ trợ xử lý lỗi, tối ưu hiệu năng và nâng cao trải nghiệm người dùng.
Có cơ hội làm việc trong các dự án thực tế với lượng người dùng lớn hơn 200.000 khách hàng doanh nghiệp( EasyBooks, EasyPos,...).
Yêu cầu
Có kinh nghiệm từ 6 tháng - 1 năm thực tập/làm việc dự án thực tế với Java.
Nắm vững Java Core, hiểu rõ Lập trình hướng đối tượng (OOP).
Đã từng làm việc với 1 trong các hệ quản trị cơ sở dữ liệu: SQL Server hoặc MySQL.
Có hiểu biết căn bản về HTML, CSS, Javascript.
Ưu tiên có kinh nghiệm hoặc từng học/làm với:Framework Spring (Spring Boot), Angular, CSS framework Bootstrap
Tinh thần học hỏi tốt, cầu tiến, ham công nghệ mới.
Kỹ năng làm việc nhóm và giao tiếp cơ bản.

Lương: 8 - 12 triệu/tháng+ trợ cấp+ thưởng dự án
Chế độ lương thưởng hấp dẫn với lương tháng 13,14 thưởng lễ tết, sinh nhật
Đánh giá hiệu suất: 2 lần/năm
Văn hóa trao đổi thẳng thắn, hỗ trợ tận tình; Sếp trẻ tâm lý, đồng nghiệp thân thiện
Khuyến khích sự chủ động và tích cực học hỏi
Cơ hội thăng tiến và thu nhập phù hợp tùy vào chuyên môn hoặc khả năng quản lý.
Được học hỏi: SDS tạo điều kiện cho mọi người rèn luyện ở mọi lúc mọi nơi, đồng hành và thúc đẩy phát triển cá nhân từ đồng nghiệp và quản lý giàu kinh nghiệm
Du lịch hằng năm với địa điểm hấp dẫn, thường xuyên tổ chức các hoạt động team building gắn kết cộng đồng, các hoạt động vui chơi giải trí cho nhân viên.
Tham gia chương trình hàng tháng, các buổi liên hoan, sinh nhật hàng tháng, tiệc noel, tất niên,...
Được tham gia BHXH, BHYT, BHTN, chế độ nghỉ có lương full phép theo luật hiện hành.

Việt, dựa vào đóng góp từ hàng trăm nghìn chủ doanh nghiệp, với sứ mệnh mang lại giá trị cho cộng đồng kinh doanh lớn nhỏ trên khắp mọi miền tổ quốc và các quốc gia đang trên đà phát triển hưng thịnh. KiotViet cam kết đồng hành cùng cộng đồng kinh doanh vừa, nhỏ và siêu nhỏ.

Với 15 năm và hơn 1,500 con người để tạo nên một KiotViet của ngày hôm nay, chúng tôi hiểu rằng các thành viên, từ quá khứ tới tương lai, là nền tảng cho KiotViet của ngày hôm nay và bệ phóng để vươn tới một KiotViet của ngày mai. KiotViet cam kết một môi trường làm việc chia sẻ thành công, cùng chung trách nhiệm.
- Tham gia cùng team thiết kế và làm rõ yêu cầu tính năng người dùng theo mô hình ATDD;
- Xây dựng chức năng của sản phẩm bao gồm back-end và front-end cho hệ thống, đảm bảo chất lượng code cũng như yêu cầu nghiệp vụ và hiệu năng hệ thống;

- Làm việc cùng các vai trò khác trong feature team để đạt mục tiêu chung của sản phẩm.
- Làm việc với hệ thống hàng triệu user, với một lượng lớn giao dịch và truy vấn;

- Công nghệ đa dạng và hệ thống code base lớn, bạn có cơ hội rèn dũa / training nâng cao kỹ năng software craftsmanship để đảm bảo chất lượng, hiệu suất tốt, trải nghiệm người dùng và khả năng tái sử dụng tốt hơn;

Chia sẻ
JOB OVERVIEW
As a QC Intern, you will support the assessment of software quality through the execution of manual testing under the guidance of the QC Lead. You will be responsible for identifying and reporting bugs and issues. In this role, you should have a keen eye for detail and good communication skills. If you are passionate about quality and eager to learn in the field of software testing, we would like to meet you. Ultimately, you will help ensure that our products and systems function correctly.
PERFORMANCE
- Assist in reviewing and analyzing system specifications under the guidance of the
Engineering Manager
.
- Collaborate with technical team members to develop effective testing strategies and plans.
- Execute manual test cases and analyze the results.
- Create logs to document testing phases and defects.
- Report bugs and issues to the development team.
- Assist in troubleshooting issues as they arise.
- Conduct post-release/post-implementation testing.
REQUIREMENTS
- Currently pursuing or recently graduated with a degree in IT or a related field.
- Basic communication skills in English.
- Proficiency in MS Office.
- Eagerness to learn and develop in the field of software testing.
- Ability to work independently and under high pressure.
- Familiarity with basic concepts of software development life cycle (SDLC) and testing methodologies.
- Understanding of how to document issues and communicate effectively with technical teams.
- Exposure to basic testing tools or environments is a plus.
- Any prior internship or part-time work in IT or software development is advantageous.

Job description
You will be involved in software testing activities under the guidance of the QC Lead:
Participate in testing Web and Mobile applications to ensure product quality before release
Analyze Business Requirement Documents (BRD) and Software Requirement Specifications (SRS) to design test cases and test scenarios
Perform manual testing, identify defects, document bugs, and track issue resolution throughout the development lifecycle
Utilize AI tools to generate test cases, create test data, analyze logs, and improve bug reporting efficiency
Conduct basic API testing using Postman to validate data accuracy and business workflows
Collaborate closely with Developers,
Business Analyst
s (BA),
Product Owner
s (PO), and other stakeholders to verify defects, perform regression testing, and ensure sprint quality
Learn and apply modern QA methodologies such as Risk-based Testing and Shift-left Testing
Your skills and experience
4th-year students majoring in Information Technology, Computer Science,
Software Engineer
ing, or related fields
Basic understanding of software testing concepts, including SDLC, STLC, test case design, and the bug life cycle
Ability to write clear, structured, and easy-to-follow test cases
Basic knowledge of SQL and API testing (Postman)
Strong logical thinking, attention to detail, and analytical problem-solving skills
Good communication skills, a proactive mindset, and the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams (Dev - BA - Product)
Understanding of the software development process and the role of QC in software projects
Why you'll love working here
WHAT YOU WILL ENJOY:
Hands-on experience testing products used by millions of users
Exposure to enterprise software development and Agile delivery processes
Mentorship from experienced QC Engineers and Product team members
Opportunity to learn modern software testing practices and AI-assisted testing
Opportunity to become a full-time QC Engineer (Fresher/Junior QC) after the internship
BENEFITS & INFORMATION:
Beyond this, we provide:
Internship allowance
Structured training in software testing methodologies and QC best practices
1-on-1 mentorship from experienced QC Engineers and team leaders
Opportunity to work on real projects and contribute to products used by millions of users
Information:
Location: Ho Chi Minh City
Working time: Full-time / Part-time (flexible based on academic schedule)
Internship duration: 4-6 months

A. JOB DESCRIPTION
Bạn sẽ được tham gia chương trình đào tạo bài bản về Automation Testing và làm việc cùng đội ngũ kỹ sư giàu kinh nghiệm. Trong quá trình thực tập, bạn sẽ:
- Tham gia khóa đào tạo về quy trình
kiểm thử phần mềm
và Automation Testing.
- Tìm hiểu các công cụ và framework Automation phổ biến (Selenium, Playwright, Cypress hoặc các công cụ tương đương).
- Hỗ trợ xây dựng và thực thi các kịch bản kiểm thử tự động cho Web/API.
- Thực hiện kiểm thử, ghi nhận lỗi và phối hợp với đội ngũ phát triển để theo dõi việc xử lý lỗi.
- Tham gia các dự án thực tế dưới sự hướng dẫn của Mentor.
- Báo cáo tiến độ công việc và chủ động học hỏi để nâng cao chuyên môn.
a) Kiến thức chuyên môn:
- Sinh viên năm cuối hoặc mới tốt nghiệp chuyên ngành CNTT, Khoa học Máy tính, Kỹ thuật Phần mềm hoặc các ngành liên quan.
- GPA từ 3.2/4.0 trở lên.
- Có nền tảng tốt về lập trình (ưu tiên Java, C#, Python hoặc JavaScript).
- Hiểu biết cơ bản về quy trình kiểm thử phần mềm.
- Có kiến thức về OOP, Git và SQL là một lợi thế.
- Có tư duy logic, khả năng phân tích và giải quyết vấn đề tốt.
Tiếng Anh
- Tiếng Anh giao tiếp tốt, có thể trao đổi trong môi trường làm việc quốc tế.
- Ưu tiên ứng viên có IELTS 6.5+ hoặc TOEIC 800+.
- Trường hợp chưa có chứng chỉ vẫn được xem xét nếu khả năng giao tiếp tiếng Anh tốt.
- Chủ động học hỏi và có tinh thần cầu tiến.
- Có trách nhiệm, cẩn thận và chú ý đến chi tiết.
- Có khả năng làm việc nhóm và giao tiếp hiệu quả.
C. WHY NTQ?
- Được đào tạo bài bản về Automation Testing theo lộ trình rõ ràng.
- Được Mentor hướng dẫn trong suốt quá trình thực tập.
- Được tham gia các dự án thực tế với khách hàng quốc tế.
- Làm việc trong môi trường chuyên nghiệp, sử dụng tiếng Anh thường xuyên.
- Có cơ hội trở thành Nhân viên chính thức sau kỳ thực tập nếu đạt kết quả tốt.

- Tham gia khóa đào tạo về quy trình
kiểm thử phần mềm
và Automation Testing.
- Tìm hiểu các công cụ và framework Automation phổ biến (Selenium, Playwright, Cypress hoặc các công cụ tương đương).
- Hỗ trợ xây dựng và thực thi các kịch bản kiểm thử tự động cho Web/API.
- Thực hiện kiểm thử, ghi nhận lỗi và phối hợp với đội ngũ phát triển để theo dõi việc xử lý lỗi.
- Tham gia các dự án thực tế dưới sự hướng dẫn của Mentor.
- Báo cáo tiến độ công việc và chủ động học hỏi để nâng cao chuyên môn.
a) Kiến thức chuyên môn:
- Sinh viên năm cuối hoặc mới tốt nghiệp chuyên ngành CNTT, Khoa học Máy tính, Kỹ thuật Phần mềm hoặc các ngành liên quan.
- GPA từ 3.2/4.0 trở lên.
- Có nền tảng tốt về lập trình (ưu tiên Java, C#, Python hoặc JavaScript).
- Hiểu biết cơ bản về quy trình kiểm thử phần mềm.
- Có kiến thức về OOP, Git và SQL là một lợi thế.
- Có tư duy logic, khả năng phân tích và giải quyết vấn đề tốt.
Tiếng Anh
- Tiếng Anh giao tiếp tốt, có thể trao đổi trong môi trường làm việc quốc tế.
- Ưu tiên ứng viên có IELTS 6.5+ hoặc TOEIC 800+.
- Trường hợp chưa có chứng chỉ vẫn được xem xét nếu khả năng giao tiếp tiếng Anh tốt.
- Chủ động học hỏi và có tinh thần cầu tiến.
- Có trách nhiệm, cẩn thận và chú ý đến chi tiết.
- Có khả năng làm việc nhóm và giao tiếp hiệu quả.
C. WHY NTQ?
- Được đào tạo bài bản về Automation Testing theo lộ trình rõ ràng.
- Được Mentor hướng dẫn trong suốt quá trình thực tập.
- Được tham gia các dự án thực tế với khách hàng quốc tế.
- Làm việc trong môi trường chuyên nghiệp, sử dụng tiếng Anh thường xuyên.
- Có cơ hội trở thành Nhân viên chính thức sau kỳ thực tập nếu đạt kết quả tốt.

- Hiện thực hóa các giải pháp AI bằng cách sử dụng các công cụ AI (ChatGPT, Copilot, GenAI tools, automation tools...) kết hợp với kỹ thuaật xây dựng web app/mobile app.

Yêu cầu
1. Yêu cầu chung:
- Thời gian làm việc: 5 ngày/tuần.
- Có thể thực tập tối thiểu 6 tháng.
- Sinh viên các ngành: CNTT, Khoa học máy tính, AI, Data Science hoặc liên quan.
- Không yêu cầu về ngôn ngữ sử dụng trên CV nhưng CV cần thể hiện được lý do tại sao bạn phù hợp với vị trí này.
2. Kiến thức:
- Có nền tảng cơ bản về AI/ML.
- Kiến thức về các mô hình AI phổ biến và cách chúng hoạt động.
- Khả năng phân tích và tổng hợp thông tin khoa học.
- MLOps: Quản lý vòng đời mô hình AI, tối ưu hóa và triển khai AI vào hệ thống doanh nghiệp.
Điểm cộng:
+ Machine Learning & Deep Learning: Hiểu các thuật toán như Random Forest, XGBoost, CNN, RNN, Transformer.
+ Đánh giá mô hình: Biết cách đo lường hiệu suất AI bằng các chỉ số như Accuracy, Precision, Recall, F1-score, RMSE.
+ Có khả năng xây dựng web app/mobile app đơn giản- mini prototype (tạo giao diện thao tác, kết nối với các nguồn dữ liệu) là điểm cộng.
3. Kỹ năng:
- Kỹ năng đọc hiểu tài liệu nghiên cứu, báo cáo kỹ thuật về AI.
- Tư duy logic, có tinh thần học hỏi, chủ động tìm hiểu công nghệ mới.
- Ham học hỏi, có tinh thần trách nhiệm, chủ động trong công việc, không ngại thử - sai - học lại..

Bạn sẽ đồng hành cùng team AI của ASOFT trong việc nghiên cứu và triển khai các giải pháp Trí tuệ nhân tạo (AI) ứng dụng vào hệ thống ERP hiện đại:
Tham gia nghiên cứu, phát triển và ứng dụng các mô hình AI/ML/LLM vào sản phẩm và dịch vụ của công ty
Tích hợp các LLM hiện đại như OpenAI, Mistral, Claude, Gemini,... vào hệ thống
Xây dựng mô hình hỗ trợ
lập trình viên
(code assistant, auto-review, v.v.)
Phối hợp xây dựng hệ thống Chatbot AI kết nối với SQL Server, file nội bộ, API hệ thống ERP
Hỗ trợ triển khai AI giúp tự động hóa workflow, phân tích dữ liệu trong hệ thống ERP+
Tối ưu mô hình AI về mặt hiệu suất, độ chính xác và khả năng mở rộng
Phối hợp với đội ngũ Dev triển khai AI vào production thực tế
Yêu cầu
Kỹ năng chuyên ngành:
Là sinh viên năm cuối hoặc vừa tốt nghiệp Đại học chuyên ngành CNTT, Khoa học Máy tính, hoặc tương đương
Có kiến thức nền tảng về AI/ML, LLM, NLP là một lợi thế
Biết làm việc với các ngôn ngữ: Python, C#, JavaScript ([protected info])
Hiểu cơ bản về các framework AI như: TensorFlow, PyTorch, Transformers, LangChain,...
Biết xử lý dữ liệu, hiểu về cấu trúc dữ liệu, thuật toán, có khả năng đọc hiểu tài liệu chuyên ngành bằng
tiếng Anh
Kỹ năng nên có:
Tư duy phân tích, logic tốt, chủ động và trách nhiệm trong công việc
Có khả năng học hỏi nhanh và làm việc nhóm hiệu quả
Tư duy mở, sẵn sàng với các công nghệ mới
Quyền lợi
Thời gian làm việc:
Full time: T2 - T6 (8h - 17h; nghỉ trưa 1 tiếng)
· Tham gia vào các dự án AI thực tế cùng team kỹ thuật nhiều kinh nghiệm
· Cơ hội trở thành nhân viên chính thức sau thực tập nếu thể hiện tốt
· Được training các công nghệ mới (LLM, LangChain, AI ứng dụng vào ERP,...)
· Làm việc tại môi trường công nghệ cao, văn hóa tử tế - đổi mới - hướng tới giá trị bền vững
· Cơ hội phát triển nghề nghiệp rõ ràng, công bằng, theo lộ trình đánh giá minh bạch
Hỗ trợ thủ tục hành chính, hướng dẫn các bạn sinh viên thực hiện báo cáo ngoại khóa, khóa luận,đề án tốt nghiệp

clean_description:
About the Role
We are looking for an experienced
Senior Cloud Engineer
with a strong background in
AWS infrastructure design, deployment, and operations
. The ideal candidate has a solid understanding of AWS core services, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), Kubernetes (EKS), and modern cloud automation practices. You will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining scalable, secure, and cost-efficient cloud environments across multiple AWS accounts.
Responsibilities
Design, implement, and manage AWS cloud infrastructure following best practices for scalability, availability, and security.
Operate and maintain AWS environments in
multi-account setups
using AWS Organizations, IAM, and cross-account role management.
Deploy, manage, and optimize
EKS (Elastic Kubernetes Service)
clusters for containerized workloads.
Implement infrastructure provisioning and lifecycle management using
Terraform
,
CloudFormation
, or
AWS CDK
.
Automate configuration management, application deployment, and system updates using
Ansible
or
Chef
.
Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize performance and cost of AWS services such as
EC2, S3, RDS, and VPC networking
.
Collaborate with developers, DevOps, and security teams to deliver reliable and secure cloud platforms.
Maintain and improve CI/CD pipelines and GitOps workflows for cloud resources and Kubernetes clusters.
Ensure compliance with security and governance standards across all AWS accounts.
Provide technical guidance, documentation, and mentoring to junior engineers when needed.
Yêu cầu công việc
3+ years of hands-on experience
managing AWS cloud environments in production.
Strong understanding of AWS core services:
EC2, VPC, S3, RDS, IAM, EKS
, CloudWatch, and Route53.
Experience operating
EKS clusters
and Kubernetes workloads, including deployment, scaling, and troubleshooting.
Proficiency in at least one
programming or scripting language
(e.g.,
Python, Go, or Bash
).
Experience with
Infrastructure as Code
tools such as
Terraform, CloudFormation, or AWS CDK
.
Familiarity with
configuration management tools
(e.g.,
Ansible, Chef
).
Solid knowledge of
Linux system administration
and shell scripting.
Experience working in
multi-account AWS environments
using AWS Organizations, Control Tower, or custom account management setups.
Good understanding of
cloud networking concepts
, including VPC, subnets, route tables, and security groups.
Strong problem-solving mindset and ability to work independently with high ownership and accountability.
Excellent communication and documentation skills in English.
Nice to Have
AWS certification (e.g.,
AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate/Professional
,
DevOps Engineer
, or
SysOps Administrator
).
Experience with monitoring and observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch, OpenTelemetry).
Knowledge of CI/CD systems (e.g., GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI).
Exposure to cost optimization, tagging strategies, or FinOps practices.

requirements: Gene Solutions is Vietnam's leading biotechnology company, developing AI-powered precision medicine solutions and genomic diagnostics across Asia. Our Oncology team builds intelligent products that support clinicians in delivering faster, more accurate cancer care. We are looking for motivated Product Engineer Interns who want to build impactful healthcare products and grow into future Product Engineers.
About the Role

As a Product Engineer Intern, you will work closely with software engineers, AI scientists, clinicians, and product teams to develop and improve Oncology products used in real clinical workflows. You will receive hands-on, on-the-job coaching through real projects and be mentored by PhD-level scientists and senior AI engineers.
Key Responsibilities
Support the development and maintenance of Oncology products and AI-powered applications.
Collaborate with engineers, clinicians, and product teams to improve product quality and user experience.
Validate AI outputs and clinical knowledge to improve accuracy.
Test new features, investigate issues, and propose product improvements.
Document findings and contribute to product development.
What We're Looking For
Behaviors (Most Important)
Extreme Ownership – Take responsibility and follow through.
Bias Toward Delivery – Focus on delivering value.
Learn Fast, Learn Always – Curious and eager to learn.
Clarity of Intent – Communicate clearly and ask questions.
Act Now, Not Later – Be proactive and execution-oriented.
Qualifications
Final-year undergraduate or graduate student inComputer Science, AI, Bioinformatics, Data Science, Software Engineering, or related fields.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Technologies you will work with:
Development: Python, REST APIs, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, ClickHouse, Airflow, Minio, Docker, Git, CI/CD.
AI: LLMs, AI Agents, RAG, Prompt Engineering, Model Evaluation.
Available to work on-site at Gene Solutions (Ho Chi Minh city office) for at least 2 full days per week.
Why Join This Internship
Outstanding interns will be considered for a full-time Product Engineer position.
Work directly with PhD-level scientists, senior engineers, and product leaders.
Learn by building real healthcare products.
Take ownership of meaningful projects instead of only supporting routine tasks. Contribute to AI-powered oncology products used in clinical practice across Asia.
Internship lasts 4 months, with performance reviews every 2 months and continuous feedback.
Allowance: 5mil/month

requirements: Company:MyStorage — Vietnam's first tech-enabled self-storage company
Location:Ho Chi Minh City (on-site, with flexibility)
Type:Internship, 3 months · Full-time (Mon–Fri)
Team:Technology
Allowance:5,000,000 VND gross/month
After the internship:Opportunity to convert to a full-time role
Most internships give you a sandbox project that gets deleted when you leave. This one doesn't.

MyStorage runs a real business — self-storage, valet storage, hyperlocal lockers, and wine storage — serving thousands of customers across Vietnam, Korea, and Japan. Our tech team is small and the backlog is not. Our AI Sales Agent, which handles customer conversations and helps drive our sales pipeline, has won regional awards for technology and innovation.

We're looking for one intern who can take a problem, build the thing, and ship it to production — withClaude Codeas their primary engineering tool. Your work will be used by real customers and real colleagues within weeks of joining.

Three months full-time is enough to do this properly: a couple of weeks to get your bearings and ship your first small things, then the rest of the time owning real work end to end. Do it well and there's a full-time role waiting.
Ship features to production.Customer-facing pages on our website (modern web stack), internal dashboards, and booking flows. Real PRs, real code review, real deploys.

Build internal tools that remove manual work.Our Sales, Marketing, and Operations teams still do things by hand that shouldn't be done by hand. You'll find those tasks and automate them — workflow automation, CRM integrations, internal bots and dashboards.
Work on our AI Sales Agent.Prompt design, evaluation, tool integrations, and the plumbing that connects an AI agent to a live sales pipeline.
Wire up data.Analytics tracking, data pipelines, and turning messy operational data into something a human can make a decision from.
Prototype fast.When someone on the team says "I wish we had X," you should be able to have a working version in front of them the same week.
Claude Code is our default way of building. That doesnotmean prompting until something compiles. It means:
You write a clear spec before you write code — because a vague spec produces vague software, whether a human or a model writes it.
You read every line the model produces and you can defend it in review. If you can't explain it, it doesn't ship.
You know when to reach for AI and when to just write the code yourself. Both are correct answers in different situations.
You test. Generated code that looks right and is wrong is worse than no code at all.
We care far more about how much real product you can ship than about how many years of experience you have.

Available full-time for 3 consecutive months.This role suits final-year students and recent graduates best — but if you're an earlier-year student who can genuinely commit five days a week for three months, we want to hear from you too
Final-year student, recent graduate, or self-taught builder — degree not required
Comfortable with JavaScript/TypeScriptorPython, and Git
You've built and shipped something outside of coursework. A side project, a bot, an automation, a tool for a friend's business — anything with real users, even five of them
Genuine hands-on experience with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) and honest opinions about where they help and where they don't
Working English (our docs and codebase are in English; the team speaks Vietnamese day-to-day)
You ask questions early instead of quietly getting stuck for three days
Nice to have
Next.js, React, or WordPress
SQL, BigQuery, or any data warehouse
Experience with LLM APIs, RAG, agents, or MCP
Automation platforms (n8n, Zapier, Make, or similar)
An eye for design — you notice when something looks wrong
Ownership of shipped features, with your name on them, that you can point to in every future interview
Direct mentorshipfrom our engineering team, plus exposure to how Commercial, Marketing, and Operations actually make decisions
A full Claude Code licenseand the tooling budget to work properly
A serious conversion path.We hire from this internship. Ship well over three months and we'll make you a full-time offer
Small-company leverage.You'll sit close enough to the business to see the effect of what you build on revenue

When someone on the team says "I wish we had X," you should be able to have a working version in front of them the same week.
How we work (and what "AI-native" means here)
Claude Code is our default way of building. That does
not
mean prompting until something compiles. It means:
You write a clear spec before you write code — because a vague spec produces vague software, whether a human or a model writes it.
You read every line the model produces and you can defend it in review. If you can't explain it, it doesn't ship.
You know when to reach for AI and when to just write the code yourself. Both are correct answers in different situations.
You test. Generated code that looks right and is wrong is worse than no code at all.
We care far more about how much real product you can ship than about how many years of experience you have.

Required
Available full-time for 3 consecutive months.
This role suits final-year students and recent graduates best — but if you're an earlier-year student who can genuinely commit five days a week for three months, we want to hear from you too
Final-year student, recent graduate, or self-taught builder — degree not required
Comfortable with JavaScript/TypeScript
or
Python, and Git
You've built and shipped something outside of coursework. A side project, a bot, an automation, a tool for a friend's business — anything with real users, even five of them
Genuine hands-on experience with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) and honest opinions about where they help and where they don't
Working English (our docs and codebase are in English; the team speaks Vietnamese day-to-day)
You ask questions early instead of quietly getting stuck for three days
Nice to have
Next.js, React, or WordPress
SQL, BigQuery, or any data warehouse
Experience with LLM APIs, RAG, agents, or MCP
Automation platforms (n8n, Zapier, Make, or similar)
An eye for design — you notice when something looks wrong

Ownership of shipped features
, with your name on them, that you can point to in every future interview
Direct mentorship
from our engineering team, plus exposure to how Commercial, Marketing, and Operations actually make decisions
A full Claude Code license
and the tooling budget to work properly
A serious conversion path.
We hire from this internship. Ship well over three months and we'll make you a full-time offer
Small-company leverage.

Buymed is Vietnam’s leading healthtech company, trusted by over 35,000 pharmacies, clinics, and hospitals through our pioneering B2B platform. We use technology and creativity to make healthcare more accessible, efficient, and customer-focused. Join us to be part of a team transforming the future of healthcare.
***Note: Our recruitment team will contact you via the email listed in your CV. Please ensure it is up to date and checked regularly.
About the Role

We are looking for aFull-stack Engineer (Golang/ReactJS)to join the Engineering team in thedevelopment of website, mobile app, and e-commerce healthcare platform, using modern technologies such as Golang, ReactJS/NextJS, Docker, Kubernetes, and Google Cloud Platform.
Key Responsibilities
1. Product & Feature Development
Build and maintain backend systemsusing Golang and frontend interfaces using ReactJS / NextJS.
Develop featuresfor website, mobile app, and e-commerce healthcare platform.
Design and implementRESTful APIs and JSON-RPC APIs to support product features.
Support and resolve issuesreported by end-users, customers, and internal teams.

Work with Product, Operations, and business teamsto understand problems and propose technical solutions.
Build solutions that improve business performance, operational efficiency, and user experience.
Use AI tools to improve coding speed, testing, debugging, and technical decision-making.

Work Experience
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related fields.
At least 3 years of experiencein backend web development using Golang.
Hands-on experience with frontenddevelopment using ReactJS, NextJS, or similar frameworks.
Experiencebuilding scalable web applications, APIs, and distributed systems.
Technical Skills
Strong understanding of concurrency patterns, microservices,and distributed architecture.
Strong experience withPostgreSQL, MongoDB, ElasticSearch, Redis, and RabbitMQ.
Familiar with cloud infrastructure, especially Google Cloud Platform.
Experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
Able to design clean APIsand build reliable, maintainable systems.
Able to use AI toolsto improve development speed, testing, debugging, and technical decision-making.
Nice to Have
Experience developing e-commerce applications, retail systems, or healthcare platforms.
Exposure to frontend frameworks such as NextJS, SolidJS, or similar technologies.
Understanding of AI Agents, including agents, skills, MCP, and context management.
Experience using Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or similar AI coding tools.
Good English communication skills.

requirements: Company Description

NeoX is a pioneering payment platform that delivers digital financial solutions tailored for B2B enterprises. The company helps businesses optimize operations, manage cash flow more intelligently, and scale in an increasingly connected world. With robust technological capabilities and top-tier security standards, NeoX supports clients across diverse industries, including e-commerce, import and export, manufacturing and distribution, and travel and hospitality. The team combines financial expertise with advanced technology to build reliable, scalable, and secure payment solutions that address complex business needs.
Role Description
You will work closely with a Product Manager and UX/UI Designer in each project.
Analyze product requirements and specifications to create, communicate, and implement the technical design.
Decide which technologies are going to be used in the project and define the overall architecture.
Learn new technologies, languages, and techniques so that you are able to adapt to the requirement of the project.
Collaborate with other team members to define the internal processes and initiatives to help the company accomplish its mission.
Qualifications
At least 3 years of experience focusing on NodeJS, ReactJS
Additional experience with Golang is a plus.Experience with web services and API integration, REST API, and technical documentation.
Experience with databases (MongoDB, MySQL, Oracle).
Experience in Microservices (Docker).
Experience with Payment Gateway/E-Wallet/Fintech/Banking is a plus.
Experience in eCommerce/Echo System solutions is a plus.
English: Not requiredExperience working in Fintech or Payment gateway company.

requirements: A Middle - Senior Fullstack Engineer (AI-Native) builds production-grade applications and intelligent workflows with an AI-first mindset across the full software development lifecycle. This role is for an engineer who does not treat AI as an add-on, but as a core way of working across design, implementation, testing, documentation, debugging, and delivery.

The ideal candidate consistently approaches work by asking whether a task can be completed entirely with AI or materially improved through AI-assisted execution, while still applying strong engineering judgment and quality controls.
Full-Stack Engineering: Design, build, and maintain scalable applications using Next.js/TypeScript (frontend) and Java/Python (backend).

AI-Native Product Development: Integrate GenAI APIs and LLM-powered capabilities into core product workflows. Build agentic flows, tool-using systems, and AI workflow automations with clear guardrails and observability.

AI-Native Engineering Practice: Apply AI-assisted workflows across the full SDLC - from design and implementation to testing, debugging, and documentation. Review and validate AI-generated outputs for correctness, security, and production readiness.
Technical Leadership: Drive architectural decisions, mentor engineers, and champion AI-native engineering practices across the team.
5+ years of professional full-stack engineering experience across frontend, backend, APIs, databases, and production systems, with strong end-to-end ownership of product delivery.
Hands-on expertise with Next.js, React, and TypeScript, including server-side rendering, component-based architecture, and state management.
Strong backend development skills in Java and/or Python, with solid understanding of system architecture, scalability, and production reliability.
Experience integrating GenAI APIs, LLM features, assistants, or AI-powered product capabilities into production systems.

Immersive adoption of AI across the SDLC. Demonstrated experience using AI-assisted development workflows for scaffolding, refactoring, testing, debugging, documentation, and delivery while critically reviewing outputs and maintaining engineering standards.

AI-first mindset. Approaches every task by asking whether it can be completed entirely with AI or improved significantly through AI, then applies the right level of human review, validation, and control.
Excellent communication skills and fluency in English to collaborate effectively in an international environment.
Competitive Pay: Attractive salary package with a 13th-month bonus and Reward bonus
Hybrid Working Model: Embrace flexibility of working from both home and office that supports better work-life balance and boosts productivity
Recognition That Matters: We celebrate your milestones with meaningful rewards and long-term commitment opportunities (after 2 years, 5 years, 10 years, etc. of service)
Comprehensive Benefits: Private health insurance for you and family member, plus full statutory coverage (social, health, unemployment)
Time to Recharge: 18 days of paid leave per year, including sick days
Continuous Growth: Dedicated learning budget, access to Udemy, English classes, mentoring, and global workshop/business forum opportunities
Support for Your Day-to-Day: Meal and parking allowances to keep life simple
Culture That Empowers: Company trips, year-end celebrations, structured quarterly team bonding, culture activities for x-team collaboration — because strong teams drive meaningful outcomes
Refer and Earn: Generous referral bonus for every successful hire you bring in
Location: Anna Building (District 12), HCMC/Lim Tower 3, Nguyen Dinh Chieu Street (District 1), HCMC

requirements: Job Purpose & Dimensions:
We are looking for an engineer to maintain and enhance a design data management platform that supports product development, documentation, and engineering collaboration.
This role covers application development, platform operations, release support, user enablement, and integration with related engineering systems.
Principal Accountabilities:
Develop and maintain application features based on engineering and business requirements.
Support software releases, testing, deployment, and user communication.
Administer platform infrastructure, environments, and system performance.
Plan and execute system upgrades, migrations, and service improvements.
Implement monitoring, troubleshooting, and reliability practices.
Provide user support, training, and clear technical documentation.
Integrate the platform with other tools and services in the engineering environment.
Collaborate with stakeholders to prioritize improvements and support adoption.
Key Performance Measures:
Platform reliability, performance, and service availability.
Timely delivery of planned releases and improvements.
Successful execution of upgrades and migration activities.
Effective monitoring, issue resolution, and continuous improvement.
Positive user feedback and strong adoption of the platform.
Ability to learn new technologies and adapt to evolving needs.
Strong collaboration and contribution to team goals.
Knowledge, Skills and Experience:
Experience in full-stack application development on ASP.NET + IIS, C# & C++ programming languages and database-backed systems.
Strong database knowledge, including query development and performance tuning.
Experience with server administration and application hosting environments.
Familiarity with cloud infrastructure and deployment concepts.
Experience with monitoring, diagnostics, and incident response practices.
Proficiency in scripting and automation for operational tasks.
Understanding of release management, testing, and deployment workflows.
Knowledge of infrastructure, networking, and migration planning.
Familiarity with project tracking and Agile ways of working.
Comfortable working in cross-functional teams and iterative delivery models.
Interest in modern development tools and continuous improvement.
Knowledge of APIs and system integration patterns is a plus.
Experience in engineering, technical documentation, or data management domains is beneficial.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
Solid understanding of modern software development practices and C#, C++ VB.NET or similar programming languages.
Bachelor or Master degree with relevant background (Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or related).
Minimum 3–5 years of professional experience in application development and/or infrastructure engineering.
Business fluent in English.
Key Relationships:
Partner with engineering users and stakeholders to gather needs and feedback.
Collaborate with product, infrastructure, and operations teams.
Work with technical specialists to support hosting and service reliability.
Engage with users to support adoption, training, and continuous improvement.
Coordinate across teams to balance service quality, priorities, and delivery.
Contribute to a collaborative and knowledge-sharing team culture.

Beyond buses, VeXeRe is expanding into flights, trains, and car rentals — giving travelers complete freedom of choice for every journey.

At VeXeRe, we believe our mission is to solve real-world social problems through technology. Our culture is built on openness, collaboration, and community spirit. Every member is encouraged to think freely, share ideas, and take ownership — with the opportunity to grow into future leaders.

We aim to become a continuously innovating tech company that revolutionizes transportation and travel across Southeast Asia through AI-native solutions. Every experience — from customer journeys to internal systems — is being reimagined to be smarter, faster, and more human.
Joining VeXeRe means being part of a young, energetic, and ambitious tech team where you’ll have the freedom to experiment, learn from top engineers, and grow rapidly as we scale.
Backend: Node.js, Express.js, RabbitMQ / Kafka, PostgreSQL / Redis / Elasticsearch, Docker / Kubernetes / Jenkins
Frontend: React.js, ES6 / TypeScript, Redux / Redux-Saga / Hooks
Develop high-quality solutions to meet business requirements by designing, coding, and shipping well-structured, maintainable software.
Identify and address technical debt & challenges: Proactively analyze areas for improvement and implement changes to enhance system performance and scalability.
Collaborate and share knowledge within the Frontend Squad to maximize team expertise and personal growth.
Take ownership: Lead a team or a product if capable, contributing to technical direction and best practices.
Proactive mindset, curiosity, and a drive to learn.
Fast learner, able to adapt quickly to new technologies.
2 – 3 years of hands-on experience in software development (frontend ).
Familiarity with macOS or Linux for development and deployment tasks.
Understanding of our technology stack (no need to master everything, but familiarity is required):
Backend: Node.js, PostgreSQL, Redis, Elasticsearch.
Frontend: React.js, Redux, Redux-Saga, Reselect, React Hooks.
Commitment to code quality:
Strong experience in code reviews.
Familiarity with unit testing best practices.
Growth mindset: Ready to grow rapidly as the company scales several times a year.
Solid foundation in computer science (data structures, algorithms).
Experience with Docker, CI/CD pipelines, or microservices architecture.
Previous experience building and shipping real-world applications.
Attractive salary package with performance-based monthly bonuses (up to 2 months’ salary per year).
100% salary during the probation period.
Performance reviews twice a year with opportunities for salary adjustments.
Hybrid working model (work from home or at the office).
Learn directly from our CTO, Tech Leads, and Senior Engineers.
Build your public tech profile by:
Writing on Medium & VeXeRe Tech Blog under your own name.
Contributing to VeXeRe’s open-source projects.
Speaking at internal or public tech talks.
Attractive stock options for long-term contributors.
Up to 30% discount on bus tickets for Vexere employees and their families.
12 annual leave days + 1 additional day every 3 years (convertible to salary).
Vibrant and friendly working environment.
Training sessions on soft skills, communication, and modern technologies.

Build automated, data-driven monitoring — from raw data, to anomaly/alert-detection logic, to a visual dashboard the team can use on an ongoing basis — so degradation is caught proactively rather than after the fact.
Document testing results, recurring failure patterns, and research findings to drive process improvement.
